messages.subject: Re: Greetings Wallace Users!
messages.body_plain:
Dear Jamie and the Wallace team (nice name :) ).

Congrats for this piece of work. Useful for several members of the broader scientific community but also for Protected Area managers and Policy makers.

I will use it the next days in detail - one question, are more algorithms planned to be incorporated ? Let say, Random Forests and Support Vector Machines ?

Looking forward

Dimitris.

messages.subject: Re: Greetings Wallace Users!
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for your interest! We plan to add some more algorithms to the workflow soon, but we haven’t decided which ones. We will keep the group informed when any changes to available algorithms are made, and will consider all suggestions.

Jamie M. Kass
PhD Candidate
City College of NY

Looking forward
